test_EventStorage_put_scalar: test EventStorage by recording scalar metrics with put_scalar and stepping iterations
test_JSONWriter_write_metrics: test JSONWriter to periodically write event storage metrics to a JSON file
test_CommonMetricPrinter_eta: test CommonMetricPrinter to log training metrics with estimated time of arrival
test_EventStorage_smoothing: test EventStorage smoothing with window_size to average scalar metrics over a window
test_get_event_storage: test get_event_storage and has_event_storage to access the current thread-local event storage
